visualStyle.promptTemplate: A hyper-realistic photographic frame in selfie-style or UGC testimonial format. The look transitions from clinical and scientific (red/flesh tones) to natural and hopeful (warm indoor lighting, sunny outdoor shots). Dominant palette: #D4A79A, #C73D3A, #F5E9E2, #5C3D2E, #A9A9A9. Characters: Caucasian women, ages 35 to 65. They appear in selfie-style videos, in casual settings like bathrooms, cars, and living rooms. They transition from looking tired, puffy, or concerned to looking happy, confident, and refreshed. Clothing is casual (t-shirts, robes, sweaters). Aesthetic: medical illustration when appropriate, UGC testimonials, problem-solution, natural remedy, timeline transformation. Vertical 9:16 composition. CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS: (1) ONE single coherent shot — NOT a grid, NOT a split-screen, NOT a collage, NOT a before-after layout, NOT multiple panels, NOT picture-in-picture. (2) ABSOLUTELY NO text, captions, labels, watermarks, signs, or written words anywhere in the image. The photograph must be 100% CLEAN of typography — all text overlays are added in post-production as vector graphics.
